interface.title: mei-friend 1.4.2 (with Verovio 6.3.0)
interface.stage_of_work: Cleaning up and correcting digitized or converted music encodings (for example OMR output) before publishing or further analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: Edit an MEI music encoding in a code pane kept in sync with a live engraved score, fix encoding errors from either side, and export the result as MEI, MIDI or SVG.

data.note: On start-up the app loaded its built-in demo (Baumann 'Mondnacht am Meer', 15 pages, with a facsimile image panel), which I only surveyed. All task work used omr_scan_needs_cleanup.mei opened through File > Open file. It has pname 'h' on n2, no dur on n3, and 5 quarter notes in a 4/4 measure 2. The MEI schema (music-encoding.org) and the MIDI soundfont could not be fetched, so schema validation and audio playback did not work. clean_example.mei was not used.

features.name: Linked source-text and rendered-view panes
features.general: Show the raw data and its rendered form side by side; selecting an item in either one highlights it in the other, and edits in the text re-render the view
features.specific: CodeMirror MEI pane and Verovio SVG notation: clicking a note highlights its <note> line, typing in the code re-renders the score (it pauses while the XML is invalid), and View menu changes the layout
steps: Open an encoding (File > Open file)
Click a note or measure in the score to highlight its markup line
Edit attributes in the code pane
Watch 'Rendering paused — waiting for valid XML' clear and the score redraw
Optionally move the notation top/bottom/left/right via View
serves_tasks: Go from a suspect item in the output to its line in the source
Fix a wrong value by typing in the source
Rearrange the workspace so the rendered output and the source sit where you want them

features.name: Select-in-view and keyboard manipulation
features.general: Pick one item or box-select several in a rendered view, then change their values with keyboard shortcuts or delete them; the changes are written back into the source
features.specific: Click a note or drag a box over notes in the Verovio score, then use Manipulate shortcuts (Shift+Alt+↑/↓ pitch, Delete; the menu also lists Ctrl+Shift+↑/↓ octave and Shift+←/→ duration, not confirmed here); the MEI updates
steps: Click a note, or drag a rectangle across several notes
Press a Manipulate shortcut (e.g. Shift+Alt+ArrowUp) or Delete
See the attribute change in the code pane
Reverse with the opposite shortcut
serves_tasks: Remove an extra item by selecting it in the output and deleting it
Adjust values of selected items with keyboard shortcuts instead of typing

features.name: Rule check with a fix/ignore results list
features.general: Run a consistency rule over the data and get a list of findings, each with Fix and Ignore, plus Fix all, Ignore all and a done counter
features.specific: Manipulate > Check @metcon (also Check @accid.ges, Renumber measures test): a panel under the code pane lists 'Measure N Staff 1 has a duration of X instead of Y' with Fix, Ignore, Fix all, Ignore all and a 0/2 counter. The panel works (Ignore strikes a row out and the counter drops), but on this file its findings were not reliable: both rows read 'duration of 0 instead of NaN' and the 5-beat measure was missed; clicking a row did not jump to the measure
steps: Choose a check from the Manipulate menu
Read the per-measure findings in the panel
Press Fix or Ignore per row, or Fix all / Ignore all
Close the panel
serves_tasks: Run an automatic rule check for measures whose contents do not fill the time signature

features.name: Insert-element palette on selection
features.general: Select items in the view and add a new element tied to them from a menu or a single-key shortcut
features.specific: Insert menu (fermata F, slur S, tie T, dynamics D, hairpins H, accidentals, trills, octave lines…) adds a control element with staff/tstamp to the selected note's measure
steps: Select one or more notes in the score
Choose an element from Insert (or press its key)
See the new element line in the code and the symbol in the score
serves_tasks: Attach a symbol to a selected item from a palette

features.name: Multi-format export
features.general: Export the current document as source, sound and image files
features.specific: File > Save MEI / Save as MEI Basic / Save SVG / Save MIDI / Preview PDF / Generate mei-friend URL
steps: Open the File menu
Choose Save MEI (the unsaved * mark clears)
Choose Save MIDI
Choose Save SVG
serves_tasks: Export the result as audio-ready MIDI and as a vector image

features.name: Editorial markup panel
features.general: Wrap a selected item in scholarly-edit markup (original vs. corrected, supplied, unclear), adding the IDs it needs first
features.specific: Annotations panel > markup tab: <choice><sic><corr>, <subst><add><del>, <supplied>, <unclear>, <orig>, <reg>; it asks to 'Add ids to MEI' first (added 19 xml:ids), then wraps the selected note (replay: n1 in <choice><sic>…</sic><corr>…</corr></choice>, after which Verovio warned 'Element note-38kzvw1 not found')
steps: Open the Annotations panel and its markup tab
Select a note in the score
Press a markup button (e.g. <choice><sic><corr>)
Accept 'Add ids to MEI' when asked
Press the markup button again with the note still selected
serves_tasks: Record a correction as an editorial intervention, keeping the original reading next to the corrected one

features.name: MIDI playback bar
features.general: Play the data as sound with a time slider; play only the visible page or all of it, with or without repeats expanded
features.specific: MIDI Playback Control Bar: play button, 0:00/0:03 slider, Speed mode checkbox, expansion dropdown (enabled when Speed mode is off). Here play was disabled (error icon) because the soundfont fetch failed
steps: Toggle the playback bar (speaker icon or SPACE)
Uncheck Speed mode to play the whole encoding and pick an expansion
Press play (here disabled: soundfont fetch failed)
serves_tasks: Play the corrected data back as sound to check it by ear
